data.body:
[P2] Reconcile the packaging-test changes with the PR description

This hunk expands the publish-list assertion to require both packages and removes the two cases requiring their deferral. The description instead states that no test on main defers them, that there are no test changes, and that no expectations were edited. This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 5.4, which requires changed expectations and their reasons to be listed. Return to the decision review required by rules 9.4 and 8.6, documenting the affected cases and justification for retiring the deferral before approval.
